verdict.rationale: Mastra provides workflow suspend/resume, snapshots, and 'time travel' to re-execute from a specific step, but this is runtime execution-state control, not version control/review/rollback of automation definitions (no evidence of versioning workflow/agent code, diffing changes, approval review of automation configs, or rolling back to prior deployed versions). missing for 10: version history for workflows/agents, review/approval workflow for changes, rollback to a previous version of an automation's definition.
